connector.name: MotorLoop
connector.registryDescription: Search and manage vehicle listings on MotorLoop, an Australian car marketplace.
connector.summary: Hosted at api.motorloop.com.au over streamable HTTP. Needs a bearer token header, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace au.com.motorloop, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A bearer token is sent in a request header. Store it outside the config file wherever your client supports it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Bearer mlp_… personal access token to manage your own listings.
